data.name: Muayyidah
data.gender_notes: Muayyidah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A woman who provides support and assists others in need. Derived from the Arabic root 'w-y-d', meaning 'to support'. In Islamic tradition, Muayyidah is a name given to a woman who embodies the virtues of compassion, kindness, and selflessness. The name Muayyidah carries the meaning “Supporter, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muayyidah usually hope their child will grow to embody supporter, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and support in times of need.
data.etymology: Muayyidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supporter, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muayyidah total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
